title: I'm on my way
setting: A follow-up call. Chris is actually in the car this time. Maya is deciding whether to get a table.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'm on my way. I just got on the freeway.
lines.spoken: I'm on my way. I just got on the freeway.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay. The freeway at this hour, though.
lines.spoken: Okay. The freeway at this hour, though.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I know. Traffic's being annoying, but it's moving. Sort of.
lines.spoken: I know. Traffic's being annoying, but it's moving. Sort of.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You want me to get a table, or wait outside?
lines.spoken: You want me to get a table, or wait outside?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Get a table. It's gonna be a minute. Give me like fifteen, maybe twenty.
lines.spoken: Get a table. It's gonna be a minute. Gimme like fifteen, maybe twenty.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I know I did. I'm not sitting in my kitchen this time, I promise. I'm on the road.
lines.spoken: I know I did. I'm not sitting in my kitchen this time, I promise. I'm on the road.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay, okay. I'll get a table. You want me to order you water or something?
lines.spoken: Okay, okay. I'll get a table. You want me to order you water or something?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. That'd be great. I'm sorry this is taking so long.
lines.spoken: Yeah. That'd be great. I'm sorry this is taking so long.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You're on your way. That's already better than 'I just left.'
lines.spoken: You're on your way. That's already better than 'I just left.'

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: A little bit. Text me when you're pulling up.
lines.spoken: A little bit. Text me when you're pulling up.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Will do. I'm on my way. For real.
lines.spoken: Will do. I'm on my way. For real.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I know. Just drive. Don't talk and look for parking at the same time.
lines.spoken: I know. Just drive. Don't talk and look for parking at the same time.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yes. Hanging up. See you soon.
lines.spoken: Yes. Hanging up. See you soon.

gist.askEn: What is Maya going to do while she waits?

details.askZh: 路况怎么样？他还要多久？
details.askEn: How's traffic, and how long does he need?

details.askZh: Maya 让他到的时候做什么？
details.askEn: What should Chris do when he's close?

glue.noteZh: on my 两个弱读词连在一起，不要听成 I'm on the way 或丢掉 my。
Give me 缩成 gimme，like 又是填充词，时间数字被夹在缩减和口头禅中间。
gonna be a 三个词都很短，minute 在口语里常表示‘还要一会儿’，不是精确的一分钟。
glue.standard: It's going to be a minute

chunks.sayAfter: I'm on my way. I just got on the freeway.

chunks.meaningZh: 路上有点烦 / 有点堵。
chunks.sayAfter: Traffic's being annoying, but it's moving.
Give me like fifteen, maybe twenty.

roleplay.setupZh: 你这次真的已经在路上了。对方还记得你上次说‘刚出门’。你要报路况，给出一个比较靠谱的时间，并请对方先占桌。
roleplay.aiRole: Maya, already there, teasing a little but helpful. She will get a table and may offer to order water. She wants a text when you're pulling up.
variants: Maya can't get a table and waits at the bar.
Chris needs help with where to park.
starters: Get a table. Give me like fifteen.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这通电话：Chris 到哪了，路况如何，Maya 先做什么，他到的时候要发消息。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell this call: where Chris is, what traffic is like, what Maya will do first, and when he should text. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
